content.overview: Section 7 is the written agreement to submit present or future disputes to arbitration.
content.study: No writing, no arbitration. A clause in a contract is enough. Incorporation by reference works if the document is identified. Non-signatories are a later fight under group-of-companies and assignment, not a substitute for section 7 writing between the parties before the court.
